Package org.apache.commons.lang3.stream

package org.apache.commons.lang3.stream
Provides utility classes to complement those in java.util.stream.

Contains utilities to allow streaming of failable functional interfaces from the org.apache.commons.lang3.functions package allowing streaming of functional expressions that may raise an Exception.

Since:
